paras: The Alpha-N LCI Front Grille Emblem Retainer is designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 LCI, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, this retainer allows owners running the Alpha-N G87 M2 Carbon Front Grille to retain the signature BMW M2 emblem while keeping the aggressive motorsport appearance of the upgraded grille.

The Alpha-N Carbon Front Grille was designed as a true motorsport component — opening up the front fascia with a CSL / GT3-inspired layout that doesn't include a provision for the factory M2 grille emblem. This dedicated retainer addresses that, allowing the OEM badge to be mounted cleanly and securely while preserving the aerodynamic and visual integrity of the carbon grille.
hl: Designed exclusively for use with the Alpha-N G87 M2 Carbon Front Grille
Professionally finished in BMW high-gloss black
Emblem not included — requires reuse of stock OEM M2 LCI grille badge from your factory grille
ft: Alpha-N LCI Front Grille Emblem Retainer for BMW M2 G87 LCI
